name: Tabayama (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tabayama village emblem in white: a disc with a stylised character of horizontal strokes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Tabayama, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1968.

features.role: Tabayama village emblem — a disc with a stylised character of horizontal strokes at the fly
